section_summary.extract_value: This section defines metacognition and reviews existing research on its effects, primarily in classroom settings. It then introduces 'The present study', which aims to expand research on metacognition by examining the metacognitive processes of adult learners mastering a complex decision-making task. The study hypothesizes a positive relationship between metacognitive activity and learning outcomes (knowledge and final training performance), and a low to moderate relationship with self-efficacy.
